question: Which option shows the correct answer when 27°C is converted to the kelvin scale?
solution:
The correct answer is __300 K__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kelvin scale__ is used to measure thermodynamic temperature.
 
• To convert Celsius to Kelvin, add 273.15 to the Celsius temperature.
 
• The formula is: Kelvin = Celsius + 273.15.
 
• In this case, when 27°C is converted to Kelvin, it becomes: 27 + 273 = 300 K.
 
• Kelvin is the SI unit of temperature and is widely used in scientific calculations.
